description: Unit test file for GCS Bucket logging functionality in the litellm project. Contains tests for logging completions, handling failures, configuration retrieval, and logging with folder-included bucket names. Uses pytest and asyncio for asynchronous test execution.

methods.name: load_vertex_ai_credentials()
methods.description: Sets environment variables and creates a temporary GCS service account credentials file from environment variables and local JSON.

methods.name: test_aaabasic_gcs_logger()
methods.description: Tests GCS bucket logging and object retrieval during a successful completion call, asserting expected payload fields.

methods.name: test_basic_gcs_logger_failure()
methods.description: Tests logging of a failed completion, verifying failure status and zero response cost in GCS.

methods.name: test_basic_gcs_logging_per_request_with_callback_set()
methods.description: Tests logging per request with specified callback including dynamic bucket name, verifying payload correctness.

methods.name: test_basic_gcs_logging_per_request_with_no_litellm_callback_set()
methods.description: Tests logging per request when no callbacks are set, including handling of failure responses.

methods.name: test_aaaget_gcs_logging_config_without_service_account()
methods.description: Checks GCS logging configuration retrieval for IAM auth (no service account), with missing bucket name raising error.

methods.name: test_basic_gcs_logger_with_folder_in_bucket_name()
methods.description: Tests GCS logging when bucket name includes a subfolder, verifying object logging and retrieval.

methods.name: test_create_file_e2e()
methods.description: Verifies create_file function is called correctly with a local file, marking an end-to-end test.

methods.name: test_create_file_e2e_jsonl()
methods.description: Tests create_file with a JSONL file, mocking HTTP client, verifying correct invocation and file handling.
